overview: Docket (1931): indexes a British plane's accidental incursion and American JASON aircraft over Kwantung's fortified zones.

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on aerial navigation in Kwantung
subfiles.about: An index sheet identifies three 1931 records concerning foreign aircraft, fortified zones, and aerial-navigation regulations in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Forbes's comments on fortified-zone flight rules, a British plane's incursion, and American JASON aircraft near Dairen.
